title: Signature Launch progress file (WF-SWARM)
description: One resumable progress file per launch, keyed by launch_id. Holds every unit from the approved launch plan, its state, and the delivered percentage. A stopped run resumes from this file: terminal units are skipped, and a crashed unit is recovered only from current admission evidence for the exact unit (a nonempty file is not completion).

launch_id.description: Plan launch_id. Also the progress-file and package key.

plan_hash.description: Hash of the approved plan this progress belongs to.

percent.description: Percentage of the approved plan's units that are DELIVERED (verified done). A dropped, skipped, stale or superseded unit stays in the denominator and contributes zero. Written on every save.

counts.description: Per-state counts written on every save.

units.description: Unit id -> state. Every page, email sequence, text set and automation from the plan.

waits_for.description: Unit ids that must be terminal before this unit starts.

charged.description: True once this unit has been charged (KIE spend). A terminal unit is never charged again.

artifact.description: Path or id of the built artifact. Existence of this path is a filesystem fact only: it never recovers a unit as done. Recovery requires current admission evidence.

verified.description: True only when admission evidence for this exact unit/revision was accepted. A legacy done row is backfilled false and counts as unverified, not delivered.

stale.description: Set when a governing input changed; a stale unit is not delivered until re-verified.

skipped.description: An explicitly skipped unit contributes zero delivered work.

evidence_digest.description: Hash of the accepted artifact set, so later consumers can tell which bytes completed the unit.

content_checked.description: True when the artifact bytes were re-hashed under a run root; declared hashes alone are not byte verification.
